collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HONESTY AND ACCOUNTABILITY (HON-01 to HON-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Small lies, kind fibs, things left unsaid, things forgotten, honest mistakes and the odd careless one. Consequences stay the size of the mistake. Privacy is not lying, truth doesn't automatically fix things, and nobody has to confess, apologize or forgive.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A friend sees someone else using the comb they gave a villager as a gift: explain, or wait for the friend to laugh.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A while ago, (friend) gave (subject) a little carved comb as a gift. (subject) didn't really need a comb, so, without much thought, (subject.he/she) passed it on as a present to someone else. Today (friend) sees that someone else using the comb, and asks (subject) about it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "I'm sorry," says (subject). "I didn't need it, and I knew someone who did. I should have told you." (friend) is a little hurt. "I made that for you." "I know. It was lovely. That's why I gave it to someone who'd use it every day." (friend) thinks about this. It helps a little. Not completely.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Is that... my comb?" "It was," admits (subject). There's a pause, and then (friend) laughs. "I can't complain. Someone gave it to ME first. All I did was carve a new handle." It turns out that comb has been passed around half the village over the years. They agree it belongs to everybody, and let it carry on its way.
